0022600098.text: The Miami Heat, now 0-1 and 14th in the East, host the Detroit Pistons, who are 1-0 and first in the East and the Central, in the second game of the Heat's season. Miami is 5th in the Southeast, one game back, and has yet to win at home this season, while Detroit has won its only game so far. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Heat won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 121-110 home win over the Pistons on March 8, 2026. Detroit's Taurean Prince is listed as day-to-day for personal reasons and is a game-time decision.
